title: Mistral 7B
authors: A. Jiang, A. Sablayrolles, A. Mensch, et al.
before: Open models came from large US labs under restrictive or custom licences.
problem: Could a small model with good engineering beat a much larger one, under a fully permissive licence?
breakthrough: 7B with grouped-query and sliding-window attention, beating Llama 2 13B on every benchmark, Apache 2.0.
why: It reset expectations about what a small model can do and made Apache-licensed weights competitive.
next: Mixtral's open MoE, and a European frontier lab.
inherits: The efficient small open model as a serious deployment target.
